questions.title: S01 at 九洲清晏 carries names of 1873. For the next modelling round

evidence.title: 同治十二年 上谕: 九洲清晏 halls renamed (as quoted in S220)
evidence.locator: S220 section 五; archive not seen
evidence.excerpt_zh: 绮春园改名万春园，敷春堂改名天地一家春，悦心园改名和春园，清夏斋改名清夏堂，圆明园九州清晏同道堂改名福寿仁恩，基福堂改名思顺堂，天地一家春改名承恩堂。清夏堂西宫门改名南宫门。
evidence.summary: The decree of 1873 gives the new names of Tongzhi's repair: 同道堂 becomes 福寿仁恩, 基福堂 becomes 思顺堂, the old 天地一家春 becomes 承恩堂. All three new names are written on the plan S01 at 九洲清晏, where its older names are not. So those labels cannot be earlier than this decree, and they are not names of the target state of 1860.

evidence.title: 三幅样式雷圆明园河道全图辨析
evidence.summary: Dates three NLC Yangshi Lei water-course plans (about 1:2000) by the changes they show. It lists dated works: 1803 channel from 宁和镇 to 秀清村; 1810 镜远洲 at 平湖秋月; 1811 恒春堂; after 1828 清晖阁 replaced by 湛静斋; 1831 慎德堂; 1836 九州清晏殿 reduced to five bays with 同道堂 added west; 1846 洞天深处 four courts to two.

evidence.title: 法国巴黎《圆明园地盘全图》考辨: names and red lines at 九洲清晏 (王其亨, 张凤梧, 《中国园林》2009 no.12)
evidence.summary: The Guimet plan also carries the labels 思顺堂 and 承恩堂, with red lines of the Tongzhi project at 九洲清晏: a fourth depth for 慎德堂, a changed 同道堂 with its theatre, 九洲清晏殿 changed, and in the east road a square pavilion, galleries and a rear hall, with a pool. The authors date the red lines to 1873-74 and the base plan to 1858 or later. S01 at the same place shows a square pavilion in a round pool in the court south of its 七间殿.

evidence.title: 九洲清晏区域考古勘探报告
evidence.locator: mhymy 档案史料 12600, free part
evidence.summary: Survey report's opening: the island site measures 220 x 120 m (printed area 25,000 m2), with 8,600 m2 of buildings, 656 bays of halls and galleries in middle, east and west routes, not symmetrical. The earliest hall, 清晖阁 Qinghui Ge, is given as 1707, and building went on into Daoguang. The survey results themselves sit behind a paywall.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.

reconstructions.title: 三幅样式雷圆明园河道全图辨析: west road of 九洲清晏 after 1828
reconstructions.why: Sequence of works on Yangshi Lei plans: after 1828 清晖阁 became 湛静斋 with 穿堂殿 and 后殿; 1831 怡情书史 and its fish pond gave way to 慎德堂; 1836 the three axis halls were rebuilt and 同道堂 added; 1846 the four courts of 洞天深处 became two. This fits the labels 前殿, ?顺堂, 后殿 on S01 as the former 湛静斋 group.
reconstructions.caveat: A reading of Qing plans, not a reconstruction.
